title: Registered Capital Increased to 2.2385 Million Yuan, Beijing Yuezhi Anmian Technology Completes Latest Business Registration Change
excerpt: Recently, Beijing Yuezhi Anmian Technology Co., Ltd., a well-known large model company in China, has undergone the latest business information changes. Relevant
content_html:
Recently, Beijing Yuezhi Anmian Technology Co., Ltd., a well-known large model company in China, has undergone the latest business information changes. Relevant data shows that the company's registered capital has been officially increased from 1.5236 million yuan to 2.2385 million yuan, which has drawn continuous attention from the industry.

As one of the representative companies in the field of large models in China, Yuezhi Anmian has developed rapidly since its establishment in 2023. Its business scope covers core cutting-edge areas such as artificial intelligence basic software development and artificial intelligence application software development. This adjustment in registered capital also reflects further actions by the company in terms of business expansion and capital accumulation.

content_html_zh:
近日，国内知名大型模型公司北京悦智安眠科技有限公司发生最新经营信息变动。 相关数据显示，公司注册资本已正式由152.36万元增至223.85万元，引发业界持续关注。

作为国内大型车型领域的代表企业之一，悦智安棉自2023年成立以来，发展迅速。 业务范围涵盖人工智能基础软件开发、人工智能应用软件开发等核心前沿领域。 此次注册资本的调整也体现了公司在业务扩张和资本积累方面的进一步动作。
